view: PA (frontal), L marker at image upper-right confirms conventional orientation
technical_quality: Adequate penetration and no significant rotation; inspiration slightly shallow. Lower zones partially obscured by large bilateral breast shadows; both lateral chest walls show curvilinear skin-fold / breast-contour lines that should not be mistaken for tubes.

devices.location: Image upper-right corner, patient left side

devices.type: Skin fold / breast contour lines (external soft-tissue artifact, not a tube)
devices.location: Bilateral lateral chest walls, running from axilla to below the diaphragm

abnormalities.finding: Pleural effusion, moderate: homogeneous basal opacity with lateral meniscus, blunted costophrenic angle and obscured hemidiaphragm
Patchy perihilar opacity, possible consolidation vs vascular crowding (uncertain)

description_zh: PA 胸部X光片：左下肺野可見均勻緻密影，左側肋膈角鈍化並呈新月狀（meniscus sign），左側橫膈輪廓被遮蔽，符合左側中等量肋膜積液（約7公分高）。心臟陰影擴大（CTR約0.58），主動脈弓突出且迂曲。右側近肺門處有片狀模糊影，右下肺野網狀紋理增加；雙側大乳房陰影遮蔽下肺野，兩側側胸壁可見皮膚皺褶線影，未見胸管、引流管或其他置入裝置。
